prompted_for: Comparing water grades without a wall of text (became CompareTable: numbered column heads in a drawing frame; on phones one column at a time behind tabs)
composition: wide desktop matrix on the left two-thirds, phone view on the right separated by a thin vertical rule
row labels in a left column, five grade columns across
section heading set large above the grid with numeric prefix '03 /'
corner crop marks and version tags at the four corners
captions under each half naming the view
layout_devices: ruled table grid with hairline cell borders
numbered column heads in square brackets [01]-[05]
mini tick-scale ruler above each limits cell
small flowchart boxes per column showing the treatment pathway with arrows and recycle loops
segmented tab bar on mobile with active tab filled navy and caret pointer
progress-bar meters under each limit value on mobile
faint dot grid in the margins
palette: deep navy for all text, rules and boxes
muted steel-blue for 'VIEW SPEC' links and the mobile CTA button
typography: mono figures with units (µS/cm, ppb, EU/mL)
larger mono values on mobile cards
rendering: UI mockup with no device frame
motifs: process flow boxes (pre-treat, RO, EDI, distillation, ultrafiltration)
motion_implied: meter bars fill to their limit
flow arrows trace down the pathway
t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup, no device frame, of a technical comparison section showing <CONTENT>. Warm off-white limestone paper background, everything drawn in deep navy hairline 1 px rules, one muted steel-blue accent for links and a single button. A ruled matrix table with bracketed numbered column heads, small tick-scale rulers and tiny flowchart boxes with arrows inside the cells. Beside it, a narrow responsive phone view with a segmented tab bar and meter bars. Monospaced uppercase type, mono figures with units, corner registration crosses, faint dot grid margins, square corners, no shadows, generous negative space, engineering specification sheet aesthetic.
signature_idea: A pharmacopoeia comparison drawn as an engineering spec sheet, each grade column carrying its own limit ruler and mini treatment flowchart, with a tabbed one-column phone fallback.
strengths: reads instantly as engineering documentation, credible to QA and validation leads
numbers with units are prominent and scannable
mobile pattern (tabs, one grade at a time) is directly buildable
palette and square corners match the brand
weaknesses: dense: every cell is all-caps mono, little hierarchy between labels and values
flowcharts repeat near-identical shapes across columns
all-caps mono everywhere is heavier than Geist light headlines
ruler scales are decorative and not to value
brand_fit_why: Navy on limestone with one steel-blue accent, square corners and mono figures fit well; headline is heavy caps rather than Geist light and space is tighter than 'space as a material'.
